confirmedFacts: Caleb Mercer is the canonical identity of the Counter-Strike player known as Atlas.
He is the Kairos Counter-Strike In-Game Leader.
He is 18 years old at the current story date.
He is American and from Silver City, New Mexico.
He is a former rifler and left-handed player.
He is the first signed Kairos Counter-Strike player.
He is the Founding Captain and only confirmed Counter-Strike captain.
He signs the first professional Counter-Strike contract in Kairos history in Episode 39.
He has authority to participate in future roster construction.
He leads his first tactical sessions and begins acting as captain rather than only as an IGL.
He prioritizes communication, trust, and decision-making over mechanical skill.
He helps evaluate Owen Fletcher and Emiliano Navarro.
He participates in the first internal Kairos Counter-Strike scrim.
He continues working directly with Adrian Vale, Luk, and Trace.
The nickname Atlas is first established in Episode 35.
Caleb remains the only signed Counter-Strike player through Episode 56.
